<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that forms a sulfonamide (functional group “sulfonamides”) from a primary amine, which matches the forward sulfonamide formation reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "NS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["primary amines"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
